settings.hero_text: Discover how effortless it is to bring your stories to life, from setup to gifting.
settings.support_text: Our dedicated support team is available to ensure your Visual Book is perfectly configured for your special moments.

settings.title: Connect
settings.text: Plug the included premium USB drive directly into your computer's port. No additional software required.

settings.title: Transfer
settings.text: Drag and drop your curated photos and videos into the book's folder. Effortless media management.

settings.title: Gift
settings.text: Slide the book back into its luxury slipcase, ready to be presented and cherished for a lifetime.

settings.title: Record
settings.text: Press and hold the tactile button on the inside cover to seamlessly capture your voice message.

settings.title: Review
settings.text: Release the button and close the card. Open it again for instant, high-fidelity playback.

settings.title: Perfect
settings.text: Didn't get it right? Re-record effortlessly until it captures exactly what you want to say.

settings.title: Download
settings.text: Get the companion app from the App Store or Google Play to unlock wireless capabilities.

settings.title: Set Up
settings.text: Pair your book instantly via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi to sync your account securely.

settings.title: Share Instantly
settings.text: Upload new memories, update albums, and share moments directly to the book from anywhere in the world.
